name: Multichain (AnyswapV4 permit)
summary: AnyswapV4Router treated a non-reverting permit call as proof of authorization. WETH's fallback returned successfully without creating an allowance, after which the router consumed users' pre-existing approvals.
notes: The AnyswapV4Router is a directly executed contract; its creation is the candidate latest executable-code event.

Multichain reported 445 WETH lost as of January 18. The anchor transaction transferred exactly 308.636644758370382903 WETH; the 445 WETH record is the contemporaneous incident aggregate across affected users and transactions. The USD value uses the nearest preceding CoinGecko ETH observation, 12 minutes 38 seconds before the anchor. Recurrence of 2023-02-15 (87 WETH component): The victim wrapped exactly 87 ETH in the immediately preceding block, moving its WETH balance from zero to 87. The loss receipt then transfers exactly 87 WETH from the victim through the MEV helper and unwraps it, leaving the victim at zero with no WETH inflow or return; the victim's maximum router allowance is unchanged across both blocks. The victim's earlier adjacent transactions are unrelated swaps, approvals, and liquidity provision, and it sends no later transaction through block 16650000. The searcher's preceding nonce is an unrelated arbitrage that neither calls Multichain nor touches the victim; following nonces are self-transfers. The 21-second-preceding ETH price is 1,548.09 USD. Recurrence of 2025-07-29 (200 WETH component): in block 23026900 the victim 0x4527106ae1a661a9d2ffc22575bacdaacb5e51e0 swapped 200 ETH into exactly 200 WETH at index 0 and the anchor at index 1 transferred all 200 WETH to 0xc0ffeebabe5d496b2dde509f9fa189c25cf29671's helper through the same router permit path; the victim's WETH balance is zero at both block boundaries and nothing is returned. Valued at the 157-second-preceding DefiLlama ETH price of 3,767.17 USD.
The 445 WETH loss is Multichain's contemporaneous multi-transaction aggregate; the anchor transaction accounts for 308.636644758370382903 WETH.

The router was exploited again on 2023-02-15 (transaction 0x192e2f19ab497f93ed32b2ed205c4b2ff628c82e2f236b26bec081ac361be47f by 0xfde0d157... and 0xd050e0a4...). That recurrence is merged here as the 87 WETH component; the code age is measured at the first exploit.

The router was exploited again on 2025-07-29 (transaction 0xae79fdcfd7c36ed654d11b352b495340bd3cc47d0849c35ac6ffa1e4859098ec by 0xc0ffeebabe5d496b2dde509f9fa189c25cf29671). That recurrence is merged here as the 200 WETH component (review source-16).
